## Why
The first self-hosted worker (#1) could not run `ghk complete 1 --summary "..." --metadata '{"changed_files":[...]}'` through its shell: a permission hook rejected the quoted JSON and flagged `{a,b}` as brace expansion. It had to write a one-off node script that called `main()`. Every harness has some quoting pain; the protocol must not depend on shell quoting of JSON.

## What
- `ghk complete|block|request-review` accept `--summary-file <path>`, `--metadata-file <path>` and `--from-stdin` (a JSON object `{summary, metadata, artifacts, reason, kind}` on stdin). Keep the inline flags.
- `--metadata` also accepts a path to a `.json` file if the value does not start with `{`.
- Update `skills/kanban/SKILL.md`, `src/context.js` (the protocol section of the worker prompt) and `references/protocol.md` to show the file/stdin form as the recommended one, with a heredoc example that has no nested quotes.
- Tests in `test/args.test.js` for the three input paths (use a temp dir; no GitHub calls — factor the arg-to-payload resolution into a pure function).

## Done when
A worker can finish with: `printf '%s' '{"summary":"...","metadata":{...}}' | ghk complete 1 --from-stdin`.
title: Terminal verbs must be easy to call from any harness: --summary-file/--metadata-file and stdin JSON
